The overnight Windows job is the release gate. Changes should remain compatible with signed and unsigned char builds.
pull_requests.review_comment: The targeted tests looked clean on the previous revision. Please check the complete strings target on Windows as well; downstream diagnostic parsers depend on stable behavior.
